segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ הַמְקַבֵּל שָׂדֶה מֵחֲבֵירוֹ וְהוֹבִירָהּ – שָׁמִין אוֹתָהּ כַּמָּה רְאוּיָה לַעֲשׂוֹת, וְנוֹתֵן לוֹ. שֶׁכָּךְ כּוֹתֵב לוֹ: ״אִם אוֹבִיר וְלָא אֶעֱבֵיד אֲשַׁלֵּם בְּמֵיטְבָא״.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» With regard to «one who receives a field from another» as a contractor «and» then «lets it lie fallow» and does not work the land at all, the court «appraises it» by evaluating «how much it was able to produce» if cultivated, «and he gives» his share of this amount «to» the owner. The reason is «that this» is what a cultivator «writes to» the owner in a standard contract: «If I let» the field «lie fallow and do not cultivate» it, «I will pay with best»-quality produce.

moves.summary: appraise and pay owner's share because of contract formula

positions.claim: court appraises expected yield and he pays the owner's share, per the contract clause
